districtFact: North Clackamas School District publishes three separate 2026-2027 student calendars rather than one interchangeable K-12 file. Elementary, middle, and high school calendars use different first days, last days, emergency make-up windows, and level-specific schedule markings; each is also available in Spanish, Russian, Vietnamese, and Simplified Chinese.

about.title: Three Student Calendars, Not One
about.content: NCSD publishes separate Elementary, Middle School, and High School calendars. Districtwide holidays and breaks mostly align, but school openings, last days, grading dates, elementary workdays, middle-school late starts, high-school finals, and emergency make-up windows do not all match. Families should use the calendar for the student's school level.

about.title: Opening Dates Depend on Grade
about.content: Grades 1-5, grade 6, and grade 9 begin September 8, 2026. Grades 7-8 and 10-12 begin September 9, while kindergarten begins September 14. The staggered sequence is printed across the three official level calendars.

about.title: Middle School Late Starts Are Calendar-Specific
about.content: The Middle School calendar marks selected Wednesdays as L1 or L2 late-start days. The official one-page file identifies the dates but does not define bell times, so families should use the date list as a planning alert and confirm the actual start time with their school.

about.title: Last Days and Make-Up Windows Differ
about.content: Elementary students have a scheduled last day of June 17, 2027, followed by possible emergency make-up days June 21-24. Middle and high school students have a scheduled last day of June 21, followed by possible make-up days June 22-25. These conditional dates are not automatic attendance days.

about.title: Every Level Has Four Translated Editions
about.content: NCSD publishes each Elementary, Middle School, and High School calendar in Spanish, Russian, Vietnamese, and Simplified Chinese. The translated PDFs preserve the school-level differences rather than collapsing them into one generic district calendar.

planningTips.title: North Clackamas Calendar Notes
content: Choose the Elementary, Middle School, or High School calendar assigned to the student before relying on first-day, last-day, grading, or make-up dates.
Kindergarten starts September 14, after grades 1-5 begin September 8; follow the elementary school's first-week communication for any additional details.
Middle school families should check the published L1 and L2 late-start dates, then confirm the bell time with their school because the calendar does not define those clock times.
Elementary students do not attend January 4, April 28, or May 12 even though middle and high school calendars do not mark those dates as student closures.
Keep the correct June make-up window flexible: June 21-24 for elementary and June 22-25 for middle and high school, only if NCSD activates those dates.
Use the official PDF in the family's preferred language; every school level has Spanish, Russian, Vietnamese, and Simplified Chinese editions.
The MySchoolDates ICS file is a one-time import. Check NCSD and the student's school for later revisions, bell times, and make-up-day activation.

districtFaqs.q: When does North Clackamas School District start in 2026?
districtFaqs.a: Grades 1–5, grade 6, and grade 9 start Tuesday, September 8, 2026. Grades 7–8 and 10–12 start Wednesday, September 9, and kindergarten starts Monday, September 14.

districtFaqs.q: Which North Clackamas calendar should families use?
districtFaqs.a: Use the official Elementary, Middle School, or High School student calendar that matches the student's school level. The files have different first days, last days, and level-specific schedule markings.

districtFaqs.q: When is North Clackamas Winter Break in 2026-27?
districtFaqs.a: Winter Break runs Monday, December 21, 2026, through Friday, January 1, 2027. Middle and high school students return January 4; elementary students return January 5 after a January 4 staff workday.

districtFaqs.q: When is North Clackamas Spring Break in 2027?
districtFaqs.a: Spring Break runs Monday, March 22, through Friday, March 26, 2027. Students return Monday, March 29.

districtFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for North Clackamas in 2027?
districtFaqs.a: The scheduled last day is June 17 for elementary students and June 21 for middle and high school students. Later June dates are conditional emergency make-up days.
Yes. NCSD publishes the Elementary, Middle School, and High School calendars in Spanish, Russian, Vietnamese, and Simplified Chinese in addition to English.
